svg.title: A CAT 048 record, cut along its UAP
svg.desc: The 52-byte record of the first data block: a three-octet FSPEC, ff ff 02, whose bits name the Field Reference Numbers present, 1 to 14 and 21, then the fifteen items in that order, each with the format the UAP of CAT 048 gives it: fixed, variable, compound or repetitive. The decoded values are those of cat048::TargetReport on this record: flight THY9TX, address 4BAACD, 194.82 NM at 128.76 degrees, flight level 360, 457 knots heading 263.6 degrees, track 482.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
